name: agentguard
description: Stops a runaway burst of sub-agents until you allow it and shows where your Claude Code or Codex tokens went. Runs on your machine.

interface.longDescription: Apply policies to supported local tool calls in Codex, ChatGPT Work and Claude Code. Record signed decisions and outcomes without retaining tool inputs or output text. Hooks fail open on internal errors.
defaultPrompt: Set a per-matter budget and a read-only tool allowlist for this session.
Show today's decisions, spend, blocks, fail-open rate, license mode and seat status.
Verify my signed decision chain and explain any integrity failure.
